what_works: Tagline 'Where You Stay Becomes The Story' anchors a place-first composition — each property is shown within its environmental context (aerial of African bush, white street with green doors). Geographic specificity in copy ('Fuerteventura', 'Madikwe') signals genuine local knowledge.
what_does_not_translate: Travel-mood quiz interactivity is a hospitality-specific tool; the transferable move is geographic-specificity-in-copy (street names, neighborhood names) treated as a credibility device.
type_observations: Clean modern sans throughout, narrative copy given generous line-height — typography deferential to the photography of place.
